elements.description:
| | TRN DONG | % GDP |
|---|---|---|
| Total expenditures | 1,435 | 25.9 |
| Expenses | 1,051 | 19.0 |
| Total spending analyzed | 376 | 6.8 |
| Direct Transfers | 40 | 0.7 |
| Education | 220 | 4.0 |
| Pre-school | 34 | 0.6 |
| Primary | 63 | 1.1 |
| Lower secondary | 49 | 0.9 |
| Upper secondary | 22 | 0.4 |
| TVET | 31 | 0.6 |
| Tertiary | 21 | 0.4 |
| Health | 89 | 1.6 |
| In-patient | 43 | 0.8 |
| Out-patient | 46 | 0.8 |
| Subsidies | 26 | 0.5 |
| Electricity | 26 | 0.5 |

Notes: Education total expenditures are based on the 2018 administrative data. Breakdowns by education level are based on 2013 UNESCO data, pro-rated to the 2018 total expenditures. Modelled estimates come close to the total level (modelled is 229 trillion compared to 220 trillion admin) and pro-rated levels except for TVET (overestimated) and tertiary (underestimated). Health total expenditures are based on the 2018 administrative data; WHO 2018 data is 154 trillion. The table uses modelled levels for in-patient and out-patient and pro-rates to the admin total for this table. The analysis uses the modelled absolute levels. Total modelled expenditure accounts for 92 percent of administrative expenditure analyzed. Source: Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Education, WHO Global Health Expenditure Database, GSO, IMF, and World Bank staff calculations.
